description: Use this for EVERY dependency or impact question: who calls X, who uses X, who imports X, what depends on X, what breaks if X changes, every reference to X, callers/consumers of X. It returns the COMPLETE reachable set as compact file:line refs, not a ranked neighbourhood, which is why it answers these questions when resolve_context cannot. Default direction is UPSTREAM (the dependents that break); direction='downstream' is what X itself depends on. radius controls hops (default 2; hub-fanout auto-caps at 1 unless explicit). Pass from+to commit hashes instead of a target to diff two analyzed commits with per-change impact. If the question enumerates files and the answer needs more than ~5 of them, this is the tool, not grep. When the question is which files use/call/import X, answer with EXACTLY the files this returns (plus the declaring file only if the question also asks where X is defined). Do not add files from a resolve_context packet that this list does not contain.

diffRadius.description: Blast-radius hops for changed nodes in diff mode. Default 1.

direction.description: Default upstream (who depends on it). 'both' runs both traversals.

from.description: Older commit hash — commit-range diff mode

radius.description: Hops. Default 2, capped at hub fanout; explicit value is uncapped.

target.description: nodeId, symbol name, or file path (required unless from/to given)

to.description: Newer commit hash — commit-range diff mode

name: blast_radius
